citizens.archiveAction: Archive the file — stops new fees; nothing is deleted

archivedToast.title: File archived
archivedToast.description: {name} — no new fees will be issued. The record and existing invoices are kept as they are, and the file can be restored.

restored.title: File restored from the archive
restored.description: {name} — new fees can now be issued on this file.
restored.failed: Could not restore the file from the archive.

citizenArchive.title: Archive the file
citizenArchive.description: A citizen file is never deleted: {name}'s file is archived — no new fees, no sign-in — with everything in it kept, and it can be restored. The reason and who asked go on the activity log.
citizenArchive.reasonPlaceholder: For example: a duplicate file for the same person, or opened by mistake
citizenArchive.requestedByPlaceholder: The citizen, a relative, the mukhtar, or an officer

nothingLeft.title: Nothing is left here
nothingLeft.body: Once these rentals end they neither own nor rent anything here, so the file does not become a non-resident record: it is archived, kept, and can be restored if they come back.

presence.loadError: Could not load who is online.

archive.empty: The archive is empty — no account has been disabled.

captions.active: Disabling blocks sign-in and moves the account to the archive; it can be undone. Deleting hides the account from both lists and blocks sign-in; their details and everything they did stay on record, and it can be restored from «Deleted staff».
captions.archived: These accounts cannot sign in. Their details and everything they did stay on record — what they registered, collected and inspected is still counted in the reports. Re-activating one returns it to the active list.

toggle.disableHint: Disable — blocks sign-in and moves the account to the archive, reversible
toggle.reactivateHint: Re-activate — back to the active list

toast.disabledDescription: {name} can no longer sign in and has moved to the archive. The account and its activity are kept.
toast.reactivatedDescription: {name} is back on the active list and can sign in again.
toast.restoredDescription: {name} is back, disabled, in the archive — re-activate it to allow sign-in.
toast.deletedDescription: {name} was removed from the staff list and the archive, and their record is kept. It can be restored from «Deleted staff».

delete.title: Delete staff member
delete.body: {name} will be hidden from the staff list and the archive, and cannot sign in. Their details and everything they did stay on record, and the account can be restored from «Deleted staff» — it comes back disabled, into the archive.
delete.hint: To block sign-in for a while instead, use «Disable»: the account moves to the archive and can come back.
delete.requireTextHint: Type the account's email to confirm

payout.description: A payment voucher is recorded under «Salaries and wages» and the amount leaves the account as soon as you confirm. A mistake is corrected by cancelling the voucher in the expense register, not by editing it.
payout.receiptRef: Payroll sheet or paper receipt no.

ownerBilling.filePaysAll: Pays the fee for all the owners
ownerBilling.filePaysNone: Not billed for it — the responsible owner pays
ownerBilling.fileUnknown: Part unknown — the owners’ shares are incomplete
ownerBilling.minePaysAll: You pay the fee for all the owners
ownerBilling.archivedOwners: <names></names>: their file is archived, so they are left out and their part falls to the other owners.
ownerBilling.mineUnknown: Your part is unknown — the owners’ shares are incomplete
ownerBilling.pickResponsible: Choose the owner who pays for everyone to see what each owner is billed for.
ownerBilling.notOnFileOption: Their file does not claim this unit

feeExemption.title: Exempt this unit from fees
feeExemption.intro: An exempt unit is charged no fee at all, whoever bears it. For the mosque itself or a public facility — not for a shop a waqf rents out.
feeExemption.occupiedWarning: A tenant or free occupant is recorded on this unit — exempting it exempts them too. A shop a waqf rents out is billed to its tenant as usual, not exempted.
feeExemption.notePlaceholder: e.g. the main mosque — council decision no. …
feeExemption.noteRequired: Write the reason for the exemption
feeExemption.noteTooLong: The reason is too long — 500 characters at most
feeExemption.unknownGrantor: a staff member no longer on record
feeExemption.liftTitle: Lift the fee exemption on unit {code}?
feeExemption.liftBody: Fees are charged on the unit from the first billing run after the exemption is lifted. The exemption and its lifting both stay in the activity log.
feeExemption.lifecycleNote: The building’s status alone exempts nothing from fees. If it cannot be lived in, use “Assess the building” (or “Assess this unit” for a single unit) in the unit matrix and record it as “Not habitable” — what is read not habitable is then exempt from every fee until a re-inspection.

citizenKind.question: Whose file
citizenKind.livesHere: Does this person live in the town most of the year?
citizenKind.estateHint: The file of an owner who has died, named «heirs of the late». An estate only owns: the widow, the children or a tenant are each filed in their own name and pay the occupancy fee; the owner's fees and empty units stay with the estate.
citizenKind.institutionHint: A waqf, an association or a public body that owns property. The place of worship itself is exempted from the unit's page («exempt from fees»); what the body rents out is billed to its tenant.
citizenKind.ownsOnly: An estate only owns — whoever lives in or rents the unit is filed in their own name.
citizenKind.shownAs: Shown in the register and on bills as: {name}
citizenKind.institutionNamePlaceholder: e.g. Waqf of the town mosque
citizenKind.estateRepresentativeHint: One of the heirs or their agent — who is told about the bills.

death.title: Owner died — make the file an estate
death.description: The file and its properties stay as they are, named «heirs of the late». If the file's kind was simply recorded wrongly, choose «Correct without a death».
death.tenancies: Rentals that end with the death
death.tenanciesBody: An estate neither rents nor occupies. Each is ended on its day and kept in the history; whoever stayed in the home is filed in their own name.
death.homesHint: If the family still lives there, choose «Occupied rent-free» and file the widow or a child as a household; they pay the occupancy fee.
death.nothingLeft: The deceased owned nothing here — the file is archived instead of made an estate.
death.suggestedReason: Owner died — the file is in the heirs' name
death.archiveReason: The file holder died — owned nothing here
death.endNotice: Ended on the day of the death. What ends leaves the form; the rest of the form is unchanged.

citizenKind.archiveSuggestEstate: If the person has died and still owns property here, do not archive the file: make it «Estate (heirs of the late)» under «Whose file», so the properties and their bills stay with the heirs.
citizenKind.retainedNote: This record was filed as a household before it became a «{kind}» record. These values are kept as history — the form no longer asks for them and nothing updates them, so do not rely on them as current.
citizenKind.institutionRents: A body is recorded as a tenant or occupant of a shop, office, clinic, warehouse or land only — it lives in no home.
citizenKind.ownerNotHousehold: The owner is not a household living in the town (lives elsewhere, an estate or a body) — they do not live in the unit.
citizenKind.deathApplied: A death on {date} is applied on this form; it is recorded when you save.
citizenKind.moveApplied: A move on {date} is applied on this form; it is recorded when you save.
citizenKind.motherNotAsked: Not asked on this kind of file.

parcelDues.title: Owed on a parcel
parcelDues.intro: What is still unpaid on a parcel number, whoever's file it is on today — before a clearance. Read-only: it issues no certificate.
parcelDues.loading: Collecting what is owed on the parcel…
parcelDues.failed: Could not load what is owed on the parcel.
parcelDues.nothingOwed: No open bill on the units of parcel {number}
parcelDues.nothingOwedBody: No open bill charges a unit on this parcel, and the people who own or live on it today have no open bill that names no unit. A bill with no parcel number on it cannot show here: this is not a clearance.
parcelDues.totalHint: The parcel's part of every open bill with a unit on it, by the bill's own lines (area or units, and owners' parts).
parcelDues.billsTitle: Bills on units of this parcel
parcelDues.partOfBill: The bill also covers other parcels
parcelDues.unlinkedTitle: Bills of the parcel's people that name no unit
parcelDues.unlinkedHint: Flat amounts, or bills from before itemised billing, on whoever owns or lives on the parcel today. Their own debts — not shown to be the parcel's.

floorCount.label: Roofed floors
floorCount.help: Every built level under a roof, the ground floor and a pilotis level included. The roof is not a floor.
floorCount.duplexHelp: Duplex: record it as two flats (one per level), or as one flat on the entrance level with both levels' area and a «duplex» note on it.
floorCount.emptyTop: {count, plural, one {The top row of the matrix holds no unit} other {The top {count} rows of the matrix hold no unit}}. The roof is not a floor: if nothing is built there, lower the count. If it is a built floor not yet divided, draw an «Empty floor» on it; if it is the upper level of a duplex, leave it.

counterPayment.title: Record payment
counterPayment.loadError: The payment demand could not be loaded.
counterPayment.notFound: No payment demand has this ID — it may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

methodBody.WHISH_MONEY: A transfer confirmed in the account

counterPayment.noCollectors: There are no staff accounts to choose a collector from.
counterPayment.tooMuch: The amount is more than the remaining balance ({amount})
counterPayment.partial: Partial payment — {amount} will remain due on this charge.
counterPayment.notePlaceholder: Anything to note about this payment…
counterPayment.failed: The payment could not be recorded.
counterPayment.replayedTitle: This payment was already recorded — receipt {number}
counterPayment.replayedBody: An earlier attempt whose answer was lost recorded it, and its details stand as first recorded: {amount}, which may differ from what the form shows. Nothing new was recorded.
counterPayment.receiptFailedTitle: Payment recorded as {number}; the full receipt could not be loaded
counterPayment.receiptFailedBody: The payment is recorded and will not be recorded again. Load the receipt again to print it.
counterPayment.collectorsFailed: The staff list could not be loaded, so a collector cannot be chosen now. Choose another payment method, or open the page again.
counterPayment.earlierReversed: An earlier attempt from this page was recorded as receipt {number}, and that payment has since been reversed. Check the citizen’s file: pressing again records a new, separate payment.

select.rowOf: Select «{title}» owed by {name} for a combined settlement
select.page: Select every outstanding bill on this page
select.pageClear: Clear the selection on this page
select.pageBlocked: Selecting this page’s bills is unavailable: {reason}

blocked.otherCitizen: the selected bills belong to another citizen, and only one person’s bills are settled together
blocked.limit: the selection is at its limit of {max} bills
blocked.mixedCitizens: this page lists bills of more than one citizen

bar.label: Bills selected for settlement
bar.count: {count, plural, one {{count} bill selected} other {{count} bills selected}}
bar.limit: At most {max} bills in one settlement.

dialog.title: Settle selected bills
dialog.description: {count, plural, one {{count} bill} other {{count} bills}} owed by {name}, settled together or not at all. Each bill gets its own receipt, and the set a combined receipt.
dialog.referenceInvalid: Enter the transfer number exactly as Whish shows it (4 to 80 characters).
dialog.collectorMissing: Choose the collector who took the money.
dialog.noRate: No official {currency} rate is set in Settings, so its notes count only against bills in that currency.
dialog.enterTender: Enter what the citizen handed over, each currency on its own.
dialog.changeShortTitle: The cash safe cannot cover the change
dialog.changeShortBody: «{account}» holds {balance}; with the notes received in that currency ({local}) it cannot give {change} in change. Ask for smaller notes, or fund the safe first.
dialog.changeShortInDoubtTitle: The cash safe may not cover the change
dialog.changeShortInDoubtBody: The previous attempt got no answer, and the balance shown may already include it. Press «Settle» again without changing anything: if it was recorded, its receipt comes back and nothing is recorded twice.
dialog.treasuryUnread: The cash safe’s balance could not be read, so the change was not checked here. The system checks it when settling.
dialog.inDoubt: The previous attempt got no answer. Press «Settle» again without changing anything: if it was recorded, its receipt comes back and nothing is recorded twice.
dialog.notePlaceholder: e.g. paid by his son at the counter
dialog.settingsLoading: Loading the currencies and the exchange rate…
dialog.settingsError: The currency settings and the exchange rate could not be loaded.
dialog.submit: Settle {count, plural, one {the bill} other {{count} bills}}
dialog.failed: Could not settle. Nothing will be recorded twice — press again to retry.
dialog.successBody: {count, plural, one {{count} bill recorded} other {{count} bills recorded}}, each with its own receipt.
dialog.replayedTitle: These bills were already settled — combined receipt {number}
dialog.replayedBody: An earlier attempt whose answer was lost recorded them, and its details stand as first recorded; they may differ from the form. Nothing new was recorded.

receipt.title: Combined municipal receipt
receipt.noPhone: The citizen’s file has no phone or WhatsApp number to send the receipt to.
receipt.shareFallback: Your browser cannot send files directly. The receipt was downloaded — open WhatsApp and attach it to the message.
receipt.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be created. Try «Print» instead.

reprint.title: Combined municipal receipt {number}
reprint.loadError: The combined receipt could not be loaded.

urgentCeiling.heading: Urgent-payment ceiling
urgentCeiling.hint: The most the accountant may pay on one voucher as an urgent payment before the payment order (art. 35). Anything above it goes to the manager as a request for the order. It does not apply to what the manager records, or to salaries.
urgentCeiling.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, or leave the field empty for no ceiling.
urgentCeiling.emptyHint: An empty field means no ceiling. The ceiling follows the currency of the account the money is paid from.
